description: USD price of a chain's native token, no gas data. Just the native-token USD price (ETH, POL or SOL), sourced from MEXC/Gate.io/Coinbase with the same price feed get_gas_price uses. Use this when you only need the asset price, not fees — get_gas_price and compare_gas_costs already return nativeUsd alongside gas data, so call this instead only to skip the gas lookup (e.g. valuing a wallet balance, not estimating a transaction). Costs $0.001 USDC per call (x402).
name: get_native_token_price
